title: Crispy Beef Stir Fry
description: A simple yet flavorful French-inspired stir fry dish made with crispy beef and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the broccoli, garlic, and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the beef is coated in the sauce.
Sprinkle the crispy fried onions on top of the beef and vegetables.
